pages.text: Exploring and building aren't separate games here. Loot from dungeons and other dimensions often goes straight into Create machines.

$(bold)Boss gear:$() Cataclysm x Create rebuilds Cataclysm's weapons and armor as Create assembly lines, and lets a crushing wheel recycle old gear.$(br2)$(l:exploration/cataclysm_create)Cataclysm x Create$(/l).
$(bold)Magic:$() Iron's Spells inks and elixirs can be filled and emptied with Create's spouts and drains. Create: Wizardry builds on Iron's Spells.$(br2)$(l:exploration/magic)Magic$(/l).

$(bold)Strange fluids:$() Create: Dragons Plus adds fan processing with dragon's breath, powder snow and more, and Enchantment Industry turns experience into a fluid you can pipe.$(br2)$(l:create_basics/fans)Encased Fans$(/l), $(l:industry/enchanting)Enchanting$(/l).
$(bold)Other worlds' materials:$() Northstar's planets give titanium and tungsten, and Twilight Forest's fiery blocks heat a boiler.$(br2)$(l:materials/ore_guide)Ore Guide$(/l).
